_register: Formal, polite address (magázás, never tegezés) wherever the reader is addressed: the 3rd-person formal imperative (Kattintson, Adja meg, Ellenőrizze) or an impersonal phrase, as Hungarian business software does; buttons, menu entries and headings use the verbal noun or a plain noun (Kölcsönzés, Mentés, Visszavétel, Vonalkód beolvasása); no jokes, no exclamation marks, no « Ön » unless the sentence is unclear without it.
_quotes: Hungarian low-high quotes „text” (U+201E opening, U+201D closing), no space inside them; nested quotes use »text« ; no space before : ; ? ! (e.g. Kölcsönözve: „{{title}}”); the arrow → stays; dates are written year-first (2026. 11. 02.) and a person's name is written surname first (family name before given name), so a template must not force « {{first}} {{last}} » order; a placeholder is never followed by a case suffix (the suffix depends on vowel harmony), so rephrase the sentence so the placeholder stands alone or before a noun (e.g. „Példány: {{title}}” rather than « {{title}}-ot »).
_plural: Hungarian has two plural forms in the plural-message syntax (one, other), but a noun after a number is always singular (3 példány, 5 olvasó, not « 3 példányok »): give both forms the same singular noun, and use the plural (-k) only when no number stands before the noun.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode (« példány » in Hungarian library software such as Huntéka and Corvina); never « másolat », which means a duplicate/photocopy.

record.note: Bibliographic record, as in Corvina, Huntéka and Koha; « bibliográfiai rekord » when the context needs it. « Tétel » is not used because it is ambiguous (item vs. entry).

patron.note: The usual word in Hungarian libraries and library software (olvasó, olvasói nyilvántartás); « kölcsönző » is not used. After a number the singular stays: 5 olvasó.

card.note: The library card, the established Hungarian term; short form « jegy » is not used.

loan.note: Both the action and the single loan; the area is « Kölcsönzés ».

return.note: The action seen from the library (taking the book back), as in Hungarian library software; the verb is « visszavesz », and « visszahozás » (patron brings it back) is not used.

renew.note: Extending the due date; verb « meghosszabbít ». « Megújítás » is not used.

due date.note: Short form « határidő » where the context is clear.

overdue.note: Past the due date; in short labels « késésben » or « lejárt » may be used for the status, but choose one of them and keep it everywhere (preferred: « lejárt »).

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return, as in Hungarian libraries (felszólító levél); « emlékeztető » is the softer word for ordinary reminders and is not used for this slip.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS); the standard Hungarian library term, short form « jelzet ».

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and call number on the spine; « gerinccímke » is also used for a plain spine label, so « gerincsáv » is kept for the band only.

label.note: Adhesive label with a barcode: « vonalkódcímke » when the barcode must be named.

class.note: A school class (3 B); never « óra » (lesson).

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for.

classification.note: The sorting scheme (UDC/ETO for non-fiction); « besorolás » is used for the single act of assigning a class mark in a record only if needed, but « osztályozás » is the menu word.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; the official term in Hungarian library practice. « Leltározás » means the inventory of assets and is not used.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « beszerzési javaslat » is the formal equivalent for a single proposal and may appear in explanatory text.

census.note: Registering the patrons with their photo; the menu entry is « Fényképes felvétel », the process « olvasók felvétele fényképpel ».

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year (3 B becomes 4 B); Hungarian schools say « évfolyam » for the year of study, and « továbbléptetés » for the action.

anonymise.note: Verb « anonimizál »; erasing a patron's personal data for good.

staff account.note: A shared login per role; « felhasználói fiók » is the general word and is not used for this.

colour set.note: The palette of the interface; written « szín » (not « color »).

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; « szkenner » is also heard but « vonalkódolvasó » is the plain Hungarian word and does not clash with « olvasó » (patron) because it is a compound.

wizard.note: Short form « varázsló »; the first-start sequence of questions.

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with; « demóadatok » is also understood but less plain.

student.note: Used in schools (diák is colloquial); gender-neutral.

teacher.note: Gender-neutral in Hungarian; « pedagógus » is the formal word but is longer and is not used for the patron type.

configuration.note: Plural noun for the settings area; the verb « beállít ».

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is « Kölcsönzés ».
